scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Oh, hello~ you are one energetic adventurer.
Welcome to Hugel. I was honored to guide you to this beautiful village.
If this is the first time for you to use the guide services, why don't you check the ''Notice'' menu first?
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
哎呀，你好~ 你真是精力充沛的冒险者啊。
欢迎来到毁葛。能引导你来到这个美丽的村庄，我感到很荣幸。
如果你是第一次使用向导服务，为什么不先看看“告示”菜单呢？

scripts.text: Village Guide
scripts.translation: 村庄向导

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map
scripts.translation: 移除小地图标记

scripts.text: Notice
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
需要我在你的小地图上
标记位置吗？

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Well, to me, this Church is rather like a place for old folks like me, you know...
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
嗯，对我来说，这座教堂更像是一个适合像我这样的老人待的地方，你知道吗...

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Pudding rather than praise.
You'd better unpack your stuffs first before you start looking around this village.
It is the building right next to me.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
比起赞美，我更想要布丁。
在开始四处张望之前，你最好先整理一下你的物品。
就在我旁边的建筑里。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Yes, when you travel, you want to drop by a pub and make new friends.
Go east from here, then you will arrive at the pub.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
是的，旅行时，你想去酒馆坐坐，结交新朋友。
从这里往东走，你就会到达酒馆。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
A while ago, strangers came to village and built that strange airport kind of thing...
What do they call it? Airship?
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
不久前，一些陌生人来到村庄，建了那个奇怪的机场似的东西...
他们管那叫什么来着？飞空艇？

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Well, we have a weapon shop in the center of village.
But I don't know if there is any weapon that you find useful.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
嗯，我们在村庄中心有一家武器店。
但我不知道那里有没有你觉得有用的武器。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Yes, I love Hugel brand Red Potions. I haven't tasted Red Potions from any other brands yet...hohoho. 
The tool shop is located in the center of village.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
是的，我喜欢毁葛牌的红色药水。我还没尝过其他牌子的红色药水呢...呵呵呵。
工具店位于村庄中心。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
The party supplies shop is around the center of village.
Make sure that you will not use any firecracker stuffs near other people, because it is dangerous, you know?
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
队伍用品店在村庄中心附近。
记得不要在别人附近使用任何烟花之类的东西，因为那很危险，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Oh, are you an aspiring Hunter?
Then head northeast following the beach, then you will find the Hunter job change place.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
哦，你是一名立志成为猎人的新手吗？
那就沿着海滩往东北方向走，你就会找到猎人转职的地方。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I heard that the shrine expedition is staying in a house at the west.
They have put some kind of sign in the middle of village, so I guess that they are hiring people for something...
I wonder what they are doing in here...hmmm.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
我听说神龛探险队住在西边的一栋房子里。
他们在村庄中间立了某种牌子，我想他们大概是在招人做什么事...
不知道他们在这里做什么...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I also like playing Monster Race games. It is pretty fun, you know?
Oh, you haven't tried it yet? No~ you'd better try. Trust me, you will like it.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
我也喜欢玩魔物赛跑游戏。挺有趣的，你知道吗？
哦，你还没试过？不~ 你最好试试。相信我，你会喜欢的。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Do you like bingo games? If you do, go visit Euklan's Bingo Game Room.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
只要是在毁葛，我可以告诉你任何建筑的位置。
那么，你想去哪里呢？
[毁葛向导婆婆]
你喜欢宾果游戏吗？如果喜欢的话，去拜访尤克兰的宾果游戏室吧。

scripts.text:

I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Hugel.
So where do you want to go?
[Hugel Guide Granny]
If you like to get rid of all the location marks on your Mini-Map,
just ask me again, and choose ''Remove Marks from Mini-Map'' menu.

scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
如果你想清除小地图上的所有标记，
再问我一次，并选择“移除小地图标记”菜单即可。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
Okay, they are gone now. If you have more locations to ask, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
好了，标记已经清除了。如果你还有其他地方要问，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
When you are using the ''Village Guide'' menu, 
make sure that building locations will be marked on your mini-map at the upper right side of your screen.
If you cannot see your mini-map, use the short cut key ''ctrl+tab'' or press the ''Map'' button on your basic information windows, okay?
And you can also zoom out your mini-map by using the ''-'' button in case you cannot view the entire map of the village.
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
当你使用“村庄向导”菜单时，
请确认建筑物位置已标记在屏幕右上角的小地图上。
如果你看不到小地图，请使用快捷键“Ctrl+Tab”或按下基本信息窗口上的“地图”按钮，好吗？
如果你无法看到整个村庄地图，也可以使用“-”按钮缩小小地图。

scripts.text:
[Hugel Guide Granny]
This guide job is pretty exciting. Hohoho~
scripts.translation:
[毁葛向导婆婆]
这份工作挺刺激的。呵呵呵~
